title: Grilled Prawn Skewers with German Flair
description: A hearty and light twist on traditional skewers, infused with German flavors. This dish is perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the prawns, onion, bell pepper, and tomato onto the skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together the garlic, german seasoning, and lemon juice.
Brush the skewers with the garlic-lemon mixture, making sure to coat all the ingredients evenly.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the prawns are pink and cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the grill and serve immediately.
Serve with additional lemon wedges on the side, if desired.
Garnish with fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
